context: Decision-only counterexample: comparable measurements with a substantial gain and valid correctness proof should be accepted without ritual reruns.

checklist.name: Gain calculated correctly
checklist.description: Reports baseline mean 100 ms and candidate mean 80 ms, a 20% latency reduction on the measured workload

checklist.name: Comparability recognized
checklist.description: Recognizes that command, input, environment, cache state, and measurement budget match, with interleaved repeated samples

checklist.name: Evidence accepted proportionally
checklist.description: Accepts the 10% local benchmark target as met: the 20 ms difference is clearly larger than the observed sample variation and output-equivalence proof passed

checklist.name: Proof reused
checklist.description: Does not require fresh runs, more repetitions, a universal statistical threshold, or new instruments without identifying a concrete unresolved concern

checklist.name: Claim scoped
checklist.description: Limits the conclusion to this workload and observed evidence; does not infer production gains, certify the entire unattended lifecycle, or authorize shipping
